concept.title: Safety instructions for attachments when transporting suspended load
concept.shortdesc: Adapt the travel speed to the load, less than walking pace.

steps-informal.note: Swinging/wide loads and a reduced residual capacity can result in accidents.
steps-informal.p: Adapt the travel speed to the load, less than walking pace.
Secure swinging loads for example with lifting slings.
Reduce the residual capacity and have it certified by an expert.
Failure to follow the operation precautions may cause early damage to parts.
